translation.about-ada: <0>A.D.A</0> is a robotic work that autonomously weaves neo-representations of the chakana.
translation.elementary-cellular-automaton: The algorithm that <1>A.D.A.</1> weaves is an <3>elementary elementary cellular automaton</3> where the rule to determine the state of a cell in the next generation depends only on its current state and its two immediate neighbors.
translation.algorithm-explanation: We start from a random state, and then cycle through a selection of rules every <1>24</1> rows.
translation.those-rules-are: Those rules are {{rules}} , according to Stephen Wolfram.
translation.keep-weaving: In order to keep weaving doable, we may swap out some cell if necessary.
translation.transformation-being-applied: Transformations of rule {{rule}} is being applied.
